items.readable_text:
Content:
To add complex numbers, we just add the real parts and add the imaginary parts separately. For example,

Content:
[MATH: (3 + 5\textrm{i}) + (2 − 3\textrm{i})|= (3 + 5\textrm{i}) + (2 − 3\textrm{i}); = (3 + 2) + (5 + (− 3))\textrm{i}; = (3 + 2) + (5 − 3)\textrm{i}; = 5 + 2\textrm{i}]

Content:
In general, we write
[MATH: (a + b\textrm{i}) + (c + d\textrm{i}) = (a + c) + (b + d)\textrm{i}.]

Content:
Subtracting complex numbers works in the same way: we just subtract the real parts and subtract the imaginary parts separately. For example,

Content:
[MATH: (3 + 5\textrm{i}) − (2 − 3\textrm{i})|= (3 + 5\textrm{i}) − (2 − 3\textrm{i}); = (3 − 2) + (5 − (− 3))\textrm{i}; = (3 − 2) + (5 + 3)\textrm{i}; = 1 + 8\textrm{i}.]

Content:
In general, we write
[MATH: (a + b\textrm{i}) - (c + d\textrm{i}) = (a - c) + (b - d)\textrm{i}.]

[MATH: ((1)/(2) + sqrt(− 9)) + (3 − sqrt(− 16))|= ((1)/(2) + 3\textrm{i}) + (3 − 4\textrm{i})]

lesson.readable_text:
Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

Content:
To add complex numbers, we just add the real parts and add the imaginary parts separately. For example,

Content:
[MATH: (3 + 5\textrm{i}) + (2 − 3\textrm{i})|= (3 + 5\textrm{i}) + (2 − 3\textrm{i}); = (3 + 2) + (5 + (− 3))\textrm{i}; = (3 + 2) + (5 − 3)\textrm{i}; = 5 + 2\textrm{i}]

Content:
In general, we write
[MATH: (a + b\textrm{i}) + (c + d\textrm{i}) = (a + c) + (b + d)\textrm{i}.]

Content:
Subtracting complex numbers works in the same way: we just subtract the real parts and subtract the imaginary parts separately. For example,

Content:
[MATH: (3 + 5\textrm{i}) − (2 − 3\textrm{i})|= (3 + 5\textrm{i}) − (2 − 3\textrm{i}); = (3 − 2) + (5 − (− 3))\textrm{i}; = (3 − 2) + (5 + 3)\textrm{i}; = 1 + 8\textrm{i}.]

Content:
In general, we write
[MATH: (a + b\textrm{i}) - (c + d\textrm{i}) = (a - c) + (b - d)\textrm{i}.]

---

Item 2 — Example: Adding Complex Numbers

Example Prompt:
Evaluate [MATH: (4 + 3\,\textrm{i}) + (1 + 5\,\textrm{i}).]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
To add complex numbers, we just add the real parts and add the imaginary parts separately.

For the given problem, we have

[MATH: (4 + 3\textrm{i}) + (1 + 5\textrm{i})|= (4 + 3\textrm{i}) + (1 + 5\textrm{i}); = (4 + 1) + (3 + 5)\textrm{i}; = 5 + 8\textrm{i}.]

Item 8 — Example: Adding and Subtracting Complex Numbers Written in Nonstandard Form

Example Prompt:
Evaluate [MATH: \left( \dfrac{1}{2} + \sqrt{-9} \right) + (3 - \sqrt{-16}).]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
First, we simplify the two complex numbers:

[MATH: ((1)/(2) + sqrt(− 9)) + (3 − sqrt(− 16))|= ((1)/(2) + 3\textrm{i}) + (3 − 4\textrm{i})]

To add these two complex numbers, we just add the real parts and add the imaginary parts separately:

[MATH: ((1)/(2) + 3\textrm{i}) + (3 − 4\textrm{i})|= ((1)/(2) + 3) + (3 + (− 4))\textrm{i}; = ((1)/(2) + 3) + (3 − 4)\textrm{i}; = (7)/(2) − 1\textrm{i}; = (7)/(2) − \textrm{i}]
